subject: Sponsor, legal & procurement path — quick scan + org chart request
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Lee <sara.lee@meditrust.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@meditrust.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Sponsor, legal & procurement path — quick scan + org chart request

Hi Sara / Tom — great conversation this morning, thanks for the time. Quick recap and a couple of asks so we can move the eval forward: 

1) Economic buyer / sponsor: you mentioned Natalie (VP Product) and possibly the CIO for larger platform approvals — can you confirm the single economic approver we should align to?
2) Security & legal: you said security will run a short technical review and legal will want a standard DPA + CSU redlines. Can you share the security contact (name + email) and legal lead?
3) Procurement timeline: rough procurement window looked like late Q2 but you said procurement sometimes needs a PO request ~4–6 weeks once pricing and SOW are approved. Can you confirm typical internal lead times and any existing vendor onboarding forms?
4) Decision criteria: please highlight the top 3 non-negotiables (e.g., data residency, audit logs, SLA) and any scoring rubric you use.

If possible can you drop a one-page org chart (or list of names and roles) for everyone involved across Product, Security, Legal, and Procurement — that will help us assemble the right internal reviewers and prepare the minimal security artifact set. I’ve copied Marissa (solutions) who will own the next-steps checklist once we have the contacts.

Next steps from our side: we’ll prepare a short security appendix (SOC2 scope, data retention, KMS options) and a draft SOW + procurement checklist to match your timeline.

Thanks again — if easier, feel free to reply with a short list or attach the org chart.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
H: +1 (415) 555-0199
hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai

Attachments: (none)
From: Sara Lee <sara.lee@meditrust.com>

Subject: Re: Sponsor, legal & procurement path — quick scan + org chart request

Hi Hannah — thanks for the recap and for pulling this together. Quick answers below and I’ve attached an org chart + our procurement checklist.

- Economic sponsor: Natalie Ruiz (natalie.ruiz@meditrust.com) — final sign-off for spend above $50k.
- Executive approver (for platform-level risk): Marcus Chen, CIO (marcus.chen@meditrust.com) — he’s typically looped for infra-level questions.
- Security contact: Tom Alvarez (I copied him) will coordinate the technical review.
- Legal: procurement@meditrust.com for standard agreements; legal lead is Priya Desai (priDesai@meditrust.com) — procurement inbox is the best entry point.
- Procurement timeline: once pricing is agreed, PO + onboarding usually takes 3–6 weeks; longer if third-party risk review is required.
- Decision criteria: 1) Data residency & encryption at-rest/in-transit; 2) Audit logs and retention; 3) Support SLA (P1 response and uptime).

I attached: MediTrust_org_chart_v1.pdf and MediTrust_procurement_checklist.xlsx. Tom — can you introduce the security engineer who will do the technical review? Prefer an email thread so we can exchange artifacts.

Thanks,
Sara
Director of Product, MediTrust Health
Sara.Lee@meditrust.com

Attachments: MediTrust_org_chart_v1.pdf (org chart, 1 page), MediTrust_procurement_checklist.xlsx (procurement intake checklist)

Subject: Re: Sponsor, legal & procurement path — quick scan + org chart request

Marissa / Karthik — forwarding Sara’s org chart and procurement checklist. Key asks for our prep: 

- Marissa: please draft a one-page security appendix (SOC2 scope, encryption, audit logs, retention policy) tailored to Data residency (US) and the three decision criteria Sara listed. Keep it consumable for Tom’s engineer and for Priya in legal.
- Karthik: based on the deal history (MT-2027-041) can you prepare a two-option commercial proposal: 1) 12-month reserved instance + support (preferred pricing), 2) pay-as-you-go with committed throughput. Include lead times for Dedicated capacity and estimated onboarding fees. We’ll need a ballpark for Procurement to slot into their checklist (they asked for rough PO numbers).

Sara / Tom / procurement@meditrust.com — we’ll aim to get the security appendix + draft proposal by EOD Wednesday PST. If Tom can introduce the security engineer (name + email) directly that would unblock the technical review and allow us to share the appendix with the right person.

Thanks — Hannah
